notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
wafw00f detects WAF (Web Application Firewall) presence and identifies the vendor/product by sending crafted requests and analyzing response patterns. Critical to run before active fingerprinting or scanning — a WAF can block, alter, or log subsequent probes and cause false negatives.

=== WHY FIRST ===
Knowing the WAF vendor informs: which evasion techniques apply, whether Nikto/scanner results may be manipulated by the WAF, what alerting the security team will see, and which WAF-specific bypasses to research.

=== CHAINING ===
wafw00f → if Wordfence (WP-specific): WordPress confirmed + WAF rules info available. If Cloudflare: CDN origin IP discovery needed before direct scanning. If no WAF: proceed with full active enumeration.

=== FINGERPRINTING STACK ===
curl banner grab → wafw00f → nikto -Tuning b → technology profile complete.
